description: China's total social financing (社会融资规模, TSF): outstanding stock, stock year-on-year growth, and monthly increments by component (RMB loans, foreign-currency loans, entrusted loans, trust loans, bankers acceptances, corporate bonds, government bonds, equity), from the PBOC monthly financial statistics report. `month` (YYYY-MM) picks the end month, `months` (1-12) returns that many consecutive months, newest first. Answers "TSF stock growth latest month", "social financing stock year-on-year 2026-09", "new RMB loans and government bond financing in September". Monthly increments are derived from consecutive year-to-date figures and labelled as such. Keyless, sourced live from the People's Bank of China.

month.description: End month as YYYY-MM (e.g. "2026-09"). Omit for the latest published month.

months.description: How many consecutive months to return ending at `month`, 1-12 (default 1).

name: china_social_financing
title: China Social Financing
